subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should this PR land as an adapter-only forward fix, leaving already-persisted contaminated recall unchanged, after it is refreshed onto current main?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but repository policy makes persisted-state upgrade scope and release inclusion a maintainer choice; automation should not silently add a backend-specific historical migration.

options.title: Refresh and land adapter-only
options.body: Rebase or recreate the clean parser patch on current main, rerun the affected checks, and track historical recall cleanup separately if users still need it.

options.title: Require upgrade cleanup now
options.body: Hold merge until a narrowly owned doctor or migration path safely repairs existing QMD-contaminated recall without parsing backend-agnostic content at runtime.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land adapter-only
recommendation.body: Rebase or recreate the clean parser patch on current main, rerun the affected checks, and track historical recall cleanup separately if users still need it.
